stance: Inflation is hot, with monthly momentum easing at the margin. October core PCE rose 0.29% m/m (prior 0.33%) but y/y rose to 3.26% from 3.14%, 1.26pp above the 2% target. Headline PCE 3.85% y/y. October CPI core was 0.30% m/m and PPI core 0.33%, so the pipeline is consistent. Cuts stay pushed back. A softer view needs core m/m near 0.2% to 0.25% across CPI, PPI and PCE. October consensus figures are unconfirmed.
